title: How to organise the cleaning equipment zone | Hall Closet
description:
Parks the vacuum, broom, and mop so they come out in one motion and go back without a fight.

This is the Cleaning Equipment Zone in the Hall Closet. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
The vacuum standing inside a taped floor outline with its cord wrapped and every crevice tool and brush head zipped in one bag clipped to its handle. Broom, mop, and duster hanging handle-down from wall clips with the heads clear of the floor. The closet door swinging fully open without touching anything.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Stand every handle up and look at the working end.
Straighten: Fit a rail and hang each tool so bristles and mop heads swing free, because heads left standing on the floor b
Shine: Empty the canister, cut the wound hair off the beater bar with scissors, rinse the mop head and dry it outside
Safety: A broom leaned against the wall slides and lands across the doorway in the dark.
Standardize: The taped outline is the standard: if you can see floor inside the tape, the vacuum is out and not yet put awa
Sustain: Switching the vacuum off is the signal to wrap the cord, not to lean it against the wall for later.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Handles hang from the rail with heads clear of the floor, the vacuum parks inside its outline, and nothing goes in wet.
